title: NC-PLUS-LOOPBREAK-SG-8: Add failure-reason capture to dispatch loop so SG-8's 22 failures produce a diagnosable outcome
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the backlog item PLUS-LOOPBREAK-SG-8 was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** Each failed SG-8 dispatch records a structured failure reason (missing capability / no doer / error class), and SG-8 is reassigned or split based on that reason
**Status:** open

Add failure-reason capture to dispatch loop so SG-8's 22 failures produce a diagnosable outcome

Triage: Capturing failure reasons requires modifying the dispatch loop in Worker code (structured records, reassignment logic), which the in-Worker doer cannot do. | first step: Write a backlog note specifying the failure-reason schema (capability_missing/no_doer/error_class) and hand off to a human/coder to patch the dispatch

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.
